title: Korean Jjigae Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: A sweet and spicy twist on traditional stuffed peppers. The Korean jjigae adds a rich, savory flavor to the dish.
instructions: Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove seeds and membranes.
In a large skillet, sauté the mushrooms, onion, and garlic over medium heat until tender.
Add the Korean jjigae sauce and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stuff each bell pepper with the jjigae mixture and top with cooked rice.
Place the stuffed peppers in a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the peppers are tender.
Remove foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until the tops are lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and a drizzle of soy sauce if desired.
